correctness.rationale: The fully displayed seven integer coefficient vectors represent nonzero elements of Q(zeta) since Phi_11 is the minimal polynomial of degree ten. Integer exact arithmetic, with zeta^10 = -(1+...+zeta^9), computes F at each of the 121 pairs and returns precisely nine zeros. An independent SymPy remainder calculation returned the same nine pairs. This is an exhaustive finite proof for the stated witness; it does not claim universal optimality.
